facts.text_en: Cerro Verde is an open-pit copper and molybdenum complex about 20 miles southwest of Arequipa; Freeport-McMoRan holds 55.08%, SMM Cerro Verde Netherlands 21% and Compania de Minas Buenaventura 19.58% (Freeport-McMoRan).
facts.text_es: Cerro Verde es un complejo de cobre y molibdeno a rajo abierto a unos 32 km al suroeste de Arequipa; Freeport-McMoRan posee 55,08%, SMM Cerro Verde Netherlands 21% y Compania de Minas Buenaventura 19,58% (Freeport-McMoRan).

facts.text_en: The large-scale expansion completed in September 2015 took the concentrator from 120,000 to 360,000 tonnes of ore per day; a 2018 permit allows up to 409,500 tonnes per day (Freeport-McMoRan).
facts.text_es: La expansion a gran escala completada en septiembre de 2015 llevo el concentrador de 120.000 a 360.000 toneladas de mineral por dia; un permiso de 2018 autoriza hasta 409.500 toneladas por dia (Freeport-McMoRan).

facts.text_en: Cerro Verde produced 863 million recoverable pounds of copper in 2025 (about 391 thousand tonnes), down from 949 million in 2024, milling 407,900 tonnes of ore per day (Freeport-McMoRan, fourth-quarter and year 2025 results, 22 January 2026).
facts.text_es: Cerro Verde produjo 863 millones de libras recuperables de cobre en 2025 (unas 391 mil toneladas), desde 949 millones en 2024, moliendo 407.900 toneladas de mineral por dia (Freeport-McMoRan, resultados del cuarto trimestre y ano 2025, 22 de enero de 2026).
